target_avatars.key_takeaway: Consider increasing video output and refining your strategy based on analytics.

episode_summary: In this episode, Sean Shackleton discusses her journey of using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool in real estate. Despite initial challenges, her commitment to consistent video production and strategic adjustments led to significant business growth. She shares insights on managing video content, the importance of hiring an editor, and how YouTube leads have transformed her client interactions.
